newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-MONACO START TITLE DEFENCE WITH DEFEAT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MONACO START TITLE DEFENCE WITH DEFEAT.

text.p: Champions Monaco, bidding to become the first French team in four years to retain the crown, made a poor start to their defence by losing 1-0 at Bordeaux on Friday.

Former Auxerre centre-forward Lilian Laslandes sank Monaco with a minute left when he beat Fabien Barthez from close range after the international goalkeeper dropped the ball from a free-kick by Brazil's Paulo Gralak.

Monaco had dominated the second half of this lacklustre match, but Bordeaux, led by veteran marksman Jean-Pierre Papin, had the best chances, especially in the first half when Johan Micoud hit the post.
"I think that, as a whole, we deserved our victory," said Bordeaux's new coach Guy Stephan. "We started a little bit tense but then there were some fine moments for a first match."
An injury time header from defender Dominique Arribage saw promoted Toulouse beat Rennes in their first match back in the top flight.
